decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for Class B1(office/light industrial) or Class B8 (storage) and for no other purpose

Condition : 5 - Prior to Unit 8 being brought into use, the parking spaces within the two parking areas shall be provided in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing 2599/TP/113 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose.
Condition : 6 - A maximium of 175 parking spaces shall be provided within the car park to the front of the site and a maximum of 14 spaces with lorry spaces shall be provided in front of Unit 8.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until full details of the soft landscaping works have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These shall include planting plans, written specifications, schedules of plant, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate and implementation programme.

Condition : 8 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 9 - The plans and particulars submitted in accordance with condition (7 ) above shall include details of the size, species, and positions or density of all trees to be planted, and the proposed time of planting.

Condition : 10 - No works or development shall take place until full details of all proposed tree planting, and the proposed times of planting, have been approved in writing by the local planning authority, and all tree planting shall be carried out in accordance with those details and at those times.

Condition : 11 - If within a period of (two years) from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation
Condition : 12 - The existing gatehouse and front boundary fence shall be retained on site.

Condition : 13 - Prior to work commencing on site a schedule of repair and maintenance of the front boundary fence and existing gatehouses shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 14 - No work shall commence on site until sections through the car park and grass bank have been submitted to and approved the by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 15 - Details of the proposed retaining wall including use of materials and appearance shall be submitted to and approved prior to work commencing on site.
description: Change of use of 8 Amalgamated Drive from car park to B1 and/or B8, demolition of gatehouse & erection of new erection of a wall to Great West Road frontage, installation of canopies to units 1-6 Windsor Close, provision of replacement car parking & re-arrangement of car park area along West Cross Way. Installation of vehicular speed restricitons & pedestrian safety measures incorporating landscaping & general improvements
